0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 14th in the East and 3 games back in the Atlantic) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, 8th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic) for their fourth game of the season. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, most recently beating Brooklyn 148-111 in Boston on February 27, 2026.
